messages:
nora: Heads-up — spotted a competitor (AstraServe) push an auto-routing fallback yesterday. Customers already asking if we can do something similar :eyes:. Quick sync?

ajay: Saw it. Looks like per-tenant routing policies that fall back to smaller models on load. Anyone have screenshots or notes?

lina: FYI — FinTech prospect asked for exactly this: fallback to quantized models during spikes, plus an enterprise toggle and SLA. They said it's a deal-breaker.

tom: From infra side: two big concerns — KV-cache isolation and model-variant compatibility for token-level state. We can do a minimal canary but need careful keying.

maria: Product framing question: parity vs differentiate. I don't want to mirror their UX. Proposal: ship a minimal API-first "fallback_policy" with modes: cost-aware, latency-first, none. No console UI for canary.

ajay: Rough eng estimate: 3 weeks for a canary (API + routing glue + telemetry) + 1 week for rollout automation. Full product (console, RBAC, pricing) ~8 weeks.

nora: Suggested launch criteria for the canary: 1) deterministic fallback behavior documented; 2) perf regressions <5% on p99 for target models; 3) telemetry for reroutes + visible metrics.

maria: Also need pricing guardrails so customers don't accidentally rack up cost. And an option to pin model versions (no silent variant swaps).

lina: Sales note: if we can commit to a 3-week canary we can accelerate two deals. They want an enterprise toggle & contract language.

tom: Risk mitigation: prefix KV keys with model-variant id to avoid cross-variant cache poisoning. Small example: 
```json
{
  "kv_key": "{{model_id}}:{{request_hash}}"
}
```

ajay: Agree. Also proposing a lightweight routing config for now: 
```yaml
routing:
  tiers:
    - name: latency-first
      max_latency_ms: 50
    - name: cost-aware
      max_cost_usd: 0.0002
```

maria: Decision proposal: scope the canary to API flag + server-side routing + telemetry + SRE runbook. No console changes in V1. Product will own checklist and docs. Who owns what?

nora: Owners: Ajay (eng lead), Tom (infra/ML), Maria (PM), Lina (sales liaison). I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to confirm scope.

release-bot: Deploy started: feature-branch/model-fallback -> staging at 2089001200

ajay: Acknowledged — I'll post the dev PR and a rough timeline by EOD.

lina: I'll draft the customer comms and sample contract language.

maria: Quick reminder — language to customers should emphasize "cost controls & graceful fallback" not "automatic parity". We avoid promising identical behavior.

tom: I'll spike KV prefixing and run regression tests on the current CI harness (will push results to the thread).

nora: Meeting invite sent for tomorrow 2089001300.

ajay: Got it — will move any blockers to #release-war-room if they show up. :thumbsup:
